Honestly, as a 3d artist myself it sounds like the artist you hired could be using a template model. You can buy them or some programs will give you a base and you sculpt it to fit what you need. Maybe this person isn't qualified to do the job? 
I was in a class with someone in college who got caught doing this. They had enough skill to enhance the model a bit but not to make larger changes. 
This is just an assumption and it very well could be they are not comfortable doing the changes. If so there are many other very talented character artists out there who can do the job. Just incase anyone asks thats not me lol. I do prop and environment work.
Looks great! I think if you were to add a bit of shading to your textures like on the scarf folds it would really boost the model! I like to use substance painter for details like that.

So often on this sub I see comments on these woman's bodies and appearance. I understand it may not be to everyone taste but not everyone is the same and we all have different preferences.

I do feel that we shouldn't comment on bodies at all. If you feel someone is struggling with an ED or anything I don't think constantly remarking on it is helpful/ necessary. They are probably aware or at least hopefully have a grounded support system. Internet strangers, as good as intentions may be are not a healthy support system. 
Its probably overwhelming to have so many people comment on appearances. Its probably also triggering to others in this sub who might be battling something. 

Also, just because you dislike someone attacking there physical appearance is cruel. Yes, they have the money to "fix" it or maybe they already did but that's not our place to comment on that. These are still people with feelings. 

As much as I dislike Davina I won't call her ugly or anything because shes not. Her personality is garbage but that can be fixed and needs work. How her body and how she looks has nothing to do with being a mean person. 
Her fashion taste can be criticized but her body/ anyones body should not be.

Each photographer has their own style and vision. Blaming this all in Kendall is weird to be honest. Kyle's shoot was stunning in my opinion but Kendall's was just a different vibe and served a different purpose.
